title: Anthropic API: Unexpected Opus Usage Limit Warnings on Pro Plan
body:
**Bug Description**
In just a couple hours of work I'm getting "Approaching Opus usage limit..." which is annoying. This started a couple days ago. I'm on the $200/mo plan. I don't want to worry about cost, and I don't want to use Sonnet because Opus is better. Charge me what you like and I'll pay it, I just want the tool to have top performance and I don't want to think about cost or usage limits. It's affecting my productivity with cognitive load. Thanks for listening.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.53
- Feedback ID:

top_comments.author: Jakepawl
top_comments.body: They nerfed the limits in half and dumbed it down. Its nefarios to treat the max plan users like this

top_comments.author: Jakepawl
top_comments.body: Inside info is they are using their servers to prioritize training for sonnet 4.5 to launch at the same time as xAI dedicated coding model. xAI coding logic is very close to sonnet 4 and has anthropic scrambling. xAI sucks at making designs but codes really well.

top_comments.author: danielraffel
top_comments.body: It seems like there's a lot of speculation in that rumor. Inference GPUs and servers are not generally used for training models like Sonnet. Training happens on specialized clusters of non-production hardware. Inference machines are usually reserved for deployment, not optimization or pre-training.
